documentation.content: The execute_tool.duration error ratio for job adk-metrics-3-6 has been above 20% for 1 minute. A dependency the agent calls is failing; the invocation may still be reporting success (invoke_agent error ratio stays 0), so users are getting turns that complete without an answer. The 1-minute hold keeps the tutorial short; a production policy should hold 5 minutes or more. See tutorial page 3.3 for the tool-vs-invocation split and 3.7 for the task-outcome counter.
